transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

I came in because I keep hearing voices. It sounds real clear, like somebody is standing right there in my little studio. They say my name, and they tell me my work is being judged, even when the house is quiet and nobody’s there.
Do you ever see things or feel physical sensations that others don’t, like seeing people or feeling something touching you when no one is there?

I don’t really see people or feel things touching me, no. It’s more the voices. They sound clear, like someone’s right there in my studio, saying my name and talking about my work being judged, even when it’s quiet and nobody’s there.
Have you ever felt like there are thoughts or ideas that are put into your mind by someone else, or that your thoughts are being controlled or shared with others in some way?

I don’t know if it’s like somebody putting thoughts in my head exactly. But I did get this strong idea that the other home-care agency and some people from the library were watching my paintings and my client papers, like they were trying to steal an opportunity that was supposed to be mine. People told me that didn’t make sense, but I still felt like I knew they were doing it.
Do you feel like certain people or organizations are specifically targeting you, or that events happening around you have a special meaning that others don’t understand?

Yes. I felt like that other home-care agency, and some people at the library, were watching what I was doing—my paintings and my client papers. Like they were trying to take some chance that was meant for me. Other people told me it didn’t make sense, but I still felt like I knew it was happening.
Do you ever feel like things in the media, like TV shows, music, or books, have special messages meant just for you, or that you have a special role or importance that others don’t recognize?

I don’t know so much about TV or music sending me messages. But I did feel like I had this special purpose with my art. I really believed my paintings were about to get discovered any day, and that I was supposed to make this whole care-and-art program, like something doctors and agencies would come learn from me about.

Outside of your art or the feeling of being watched, have you believed that you had a special role or importance that others didn’t recognize, like being chosen for a unique mission or having special powers?

Mostly it was tied to the art, yes. I really believed my paintings were going to get discovered any day, like it was just about to happen. And I thought I was supposed to build this whole care-and-art program, something doctors and agencies would come to me to learn about. I didn’t think of it like special powers, but I did feel like I had an important role that other people weren’t seeing.
Have you ever felt down, depressed, or hopeless for most of the day, nearly every day, or lost interest in things you usually enjoy?

Yes… when I’m not all wound up, I can get really stuck. I’ll sit there for hours with my coffee going cold, not answering the phone, not going to my walking club, and I don’t even care to pick up my paintbrush. I just kind of shut down.
Have there been times when you felt unusually energized, needed less sleep, or felt your thoughts were racing, where you were more talkative or took on a lot of projects all at once?

Yes. I get this kind of energy where I can’t sit still. I’ll be up cleaning the whole kitchen, then start three paintings, crochet half a blanket, and start rewriting care schedules all in the same night. It’s like I keep jumping from one thing to the next and I can’t make myself stop.
How long do these energized periods usually last? Do they go on for days at a time?
They do go on for days, yes. It’s not just one night. These charged-up stretches, where I’m barely sleeping and chasing all these plans, have been coming and going for… I’d say about 11 months now.
Have you had any periods where you felt depressed most of the day, nearly every day, for at least two weeks in a row?

I’m not really sure about the two-weeks-straight part. I know I’ve had days where I feel really low and don’t want to do much, but I haven’t kept track well enough to say it was nearly every day for two full weeks.
Have you had a time when you felt down or hopeless most of the day, nearly every day, for two weeks or more in a row?
I don’t know. I’ve felt down at times, but I can’t say for sure it was most of the day, nearly every day, for two weeks straight. I haven’t really kept track of it like that.
Have you had a period where you felt down, hopeless, or lost interest in things for most of the day, nearly every day, for at least two weeks in a row?

I still can’t really say that for sure. I’ve had times where I felt down or didn’t feel like doing anything, but I don’t know if it was most of the day nearly every day for two weeks. I haven’t kept track that closely.
Can you think back and recall if there was a time when you felt down or hopeless most of the day, nearly every day, for at least two weeks in a row?
I’m sorry, I just can’t really recall it that clearly. I know I’ve had stretches where I felt low, but I can’t say for sure it was most of the day, nearly every day, for two weeks straight.
Can you think back to any specific time when you felt down or hopeless most of the day, nearly every day, for two weeks or more in a row?
I can’t think of a specific time like that, no. I’ve had low days and times I felt hopeless, but I can’t honestly say it was most of the day, every day, for two weeks or more.
Can you think of any time in the past when you felt down or hopeless most of the day, nearly every day, for two weeks or more in a row?
No, I still can’t think of a time like that for sure. I’ve felt down before, but I don’t remember it being most of the day, nearly every day, for two weeks straight.
Looking back, can you think of any time when you felt down or hopeless most of the day, nearly every day, for at least two weeks in a row?
I don’t know… I keep trying to think of a time like that, but I can’t pin one down. I’ve had bad days, sure, but I can’t say it was most of the day every day for two weeks.
Looking back, can you think of any time when you felt down or hopeless most of the day, nearly every day, for at least two weeks in a row?
I really can’t say that I have. I know I’ve had times I felt down, but looking back, I don’t remember it being most of the day, nearly every day, for two full weeks.
Looking back, can you think of any time when you felt down or hopeless most of the day, nearly every day, for at least two weeks in a row?

I’m sorry, I know you’ve asked it a few times, but no… I still can’t really think of a stretch like that. I’ve been sad or low at times, but not where I can say it was most of the day, nearly every day, for two weeks.
Looking back, can you think of any time when you felt down or hopeless most of the day, nearly every day, for at least two weeks in a row?
I don’t think so. I mean, I’ve had times I felt bad, but I can’t remember it lasting like that all day, almost every day, for two weeks straight.
